question: Can the ending of the three-cycle chain be read as 圆融 - the sealable component closing while the committed component carries out, both in full, without netting, without one obstructing the other and without compromise - while the beginning is split into resetable obstructions and non-resetable commitments, the middle carries the five-fold double cycle of generation and overcoming, the chain length is compared exactly against the 260, 2920 and 18980 day commensurabilities, the committed component is a one-way reservoir with a threshold and hysteresis, sealing is refused for what is by definition a leak, and four factors are classified on each side as corrections to be made, structures to be preserved, or explicitly unquantified?
level: Bounded external exact calibration of a declared construction. No physical claim, no forecast, no skill claim, no magnitude for any physical quantity, no data read or used.

parent_contracts.relation: in force, retained byte for byte; conflicts are reported, not resolved by editing
its four amendments are inherited unchanged
the surgery run of note 0237; its two retained failures and its undecided necessity of opposite chirality carry forward and are not repaired here

declared_reading.ending_rounded: The ending is 圆融, not a choice between closure and openness. Both terminal conditions hold IN FULL: the sealable component closes (終養始, the fixed point of the annual return) and the committed component carries out of the chain (未濟, the ratchet debt written out and not discharged). Three prohibitions: no netting (no component's residual may be reduced by another's surplus), no mutual obstruction (satisfying one condition may not change the other's verdict) and no compromise (both conditions must hold exactly, not approximately).
declared_reading.yi_as_contrast_family: The Yi pair 既濟/未濟 is demoted from a terminal reading to the contrast family: an either-or ending, a forced-open ending and a forced-closed ending must each FAIL the rounded ending. The existing mapping is reused: the mutual-measuring diagonal a = b is 81 points (all in position) and its complement is 6,480 points (none in position).
declared_reading.beginning_split: The beginning is split into two obstruction classes: RESETABLE obstructions (phase misalignment and the step-carry remainder, the position of the Wayeb days and of the calendar carries) which a declared reset may clear, and NON-RESETABLE commitments (the one-way reservoir state) which no reset may clear and which must be written out and carried. A reset that clears a non-resetable commitment must be rejected.
declared_reading.middle_five: The middle group carries a five-point structure with TWO directed cycles on the same five points: generation as +1 and overcoming as +2 modulo five, both generators because five is prime. Rejecting one cycle, or identifying the two, must both fail.
declared_reading.astronomical_remainders: The chain length is compared exactly, in integers, against 260 (Tzolkin), 2920 (five Venus synodic periods, eight solar years) and 18980 (the calendar round) days; the remainders are reported and the assertion that three annual cycles do NOT close any of them is made explicitly.
declared_reading.three_is_not_a_degree: The run asserts that the three-year time period is not a third-degree spherical harmonic and not a failure of injectivity, and rejects any reading that identifies them.
declared_reading.one_way_commitment: The committed component is a declared one-way reservoir: non-decreasing, with a declared threshold branch and hysteresis (the thaw path and the refreeze path differ on a declared loop). The declared first-order relaxation reservoir of the parent chain must FAIL the monotonicity and hysteresis controls, which is how the claim that the old shape was insufficient is made falsifiable.
declared_reading.sealing_refused_for_a_leak: The sealing condition is REFUSED for a component that is by definition a leak: the committed component may be accounted but never sealed, and a chain that treats it as sealable - allowing it to offset a sealing violation - must be rejected.
declared_reading.factor_classification: Four factors - aerosols, low cloud, water vapour and wildfire - are classified on each of the two sides (north and south) into exactly one of three declarations: a CORRECTION to be made with its correction declared, a STRUCTURE to be preserved, or EXPLICITLY UNQUANTIFIED (recorded separately, never fused and never given a magnitude). The declared placement is: aerosols as the north-side structure that sets the interhemispheric asymmetry and defines the cold-injecting side; low cloud as the south-weighted coupler that turns fast perturbations into structural radiative effects; water vapour as the fast reversible amplifier that is also the carrier of the south-branch injection; wildfire as a threshold source acting on both sides, with black carbon on snow attacking the sealing side's albedo and with partial ratchet behaviour. NO MAGNITUDE IS GIVEN FOR ANY OF THEM.
declared_reading.uncertainty_terms: The separated uncertainty accounting of supplement one gains a fourth term, committed-but-unquantified, recorded separately at every seam and never fused with mapping, bias or sampling.

objects.terminal_pair: The two terminal conditions as a conjunction, with their residual records kept separate.
objects.obstruction_classes: The resetable class and the non-resetable class, each with its write-out requirement and its reset rule.
objects.five_point: The five-point middle with its two directed cycles.
objects.commensurabilities: The three integer day counts and the exact remainders of the chain against each.
objects.commitment_reservoir: The one-way, threshold, hysteretic reservoir, with its monotone state and its thaw and refreeze paths.
objects.classification: The four-by-two table of factors and sides, each cell carrying exactly one of the three declarations.

controls: Either-or ending, forced-open ending and forced-closed ending must each fail the rounded ending.
Netting must fail: a terminal in which one component's surplus reduces the other's residual is rejected.
Obstruction must fail: a terminal in which satisfying one condition flips the other's verdict is rejected.
Compromise must fail: a terminal in which both conditions hold only approximately is rejected.
Reset: a reset applied to a non-resetable commitment must be rejected; a reset applied to a resetable obstruction must be accepted.
Five: rejecting one of the two cycles, or identifying them, must both fail.
Remainders: the three exact remainders must be reported, and a claim that the chain closes any commensurability must be rejected.
Reversible reservoir: the declared first-order relaxation must fail the monotonicity and hysteresis controls, so that the one-way shape is doing work.
Sealing: treating the committed component as sealable, or letting it offset a sealing violation, must be rejected.

Classification: a chain that treats a STRUCTURE cell as a correctable perturbation, or a ratchet cell as reversible, or a symmetric north-south treatment, must each be rejected; and fusing the correction account with the structure account must be rejected.

Inherited: the sampling-change invariance control, the separated-uncertainty control, the layer-wise sealing control, the identity-loop control and the atmospheric-chain memory-loss control all still run.
acceptance: Every acceptance assertion is exact; no floating-point value appears in any acceptance test or in the retained payload; no magnitude is given for any physical quantity. The run reports the terminal conjunction with both residuals, the four prohibitions with their rejections, the two obstruction classes, the five-point double cycle, the three exact remainders, the one-way reservoir with its threshold and hysteresis and the failed reversible control, the refusal of sealing for the leaking component, the four-by-two classification with its three declarations and its rejections, the fourth uncertainty term, and every inherited control - including any control that failed to discriminate.
